name: StellarDrive Demo TF Advanced
author: Romalaure
description: TF group advanced mods, in English, French and Spanish (setting Language). 7 new planets around Otrera and a second galaxy, Erebus, reached through a portal: deserts, mountains, glaciers, a futuristic abandoned city, jungle, volcanic, ocean, fungal and crystal worlds, a pirate fortress planet. Ruins, villages, wrecks and buildings with chests, new ores (titanium, quartz, cryonite, meteorite, uranium), nuclear power and dark matter. Space stations to build (habitation, corridors, airlock, docking, ship hangar, laboratory, infirmary, life support, observatory), a trading station with a merchant (daily deliveries, reputation), weather (rain, storms, snow, sandstorms, ash, auroras), nature scenes (camps, forest floors, boulders; Kenney Nature Kit, CC0), setting LowPerformance for modest computers, wood, glass and iron building parts. Ship computer screens, advanced engines, battery and breaker, force fields, portal generator, cartography table, research tree branch. 3 black holes, abandoned stations, asteroid fields, pirates (with Arsenal) with incoming raids, pirate radars (1,000 / 5,000 / 20,000 km) and a stealth generator. TF equipment: lamps, surveillance camera and tablet, teleport capsule, radio, tool rack, infinite parts. In-game wiki in the Guide (G). REQUIRED: MelonLoader 0.7.3 and SDModKit (without SDModKit the mod's parts, cables and camera do not work). RECOMMENDED: Arsenal (pirates, raids, weapon-proof force fields; without it there are no pirates). If you also use the TF mod (StellarDriveDemoTF), it must be 0.15 or newer. Every player needs the mod, in the same version.
